tells.1: Templated structure with colon-led headings and a tidy bullet list.
tells.2: Slightly performative casualness and a generic takeaway line.
tells.4: Overly condensed and polished into a neat LinkedIn-style lesson.
tells.5: Stiff formal phrasing mixed with an exclamation and clunky bullet fragments.

reason: Version 3 feels most like a real operator sharing a credible, nuanced result; its concrete costs, time savings, and honest caveats build trust even without a direct engagement question.
